Step-by-Step Audio Guided Tour: Boston (Massachusetts politics and current affairs)

Stop 1: Faneuil Hall

Coordinates: 42.3600, -71.0568

Faneuil Hall has hosted public debate since 1743, when it opened as a market and meeting hall.

Directions: Walk north toward Congress Street.

Stop 3: Boston City Hall

Coordinates: 42.3604, -71.0580

Boston City Hall breaks from the city's older rhythms in nearly every way. In 1969, the American Institute of Architects awarded the building its Honor Award, placing City Hall into the national conversation about what civic architecture could Seven years later, in 1976, a poll of architects and critics ranked it among the greatest buildings in the United States.

Directions: Continue up Beacon Street toward the State House.

Stop 5: Massachusetts State House

Coordinates: 42.3588, -71.0638

The Massachusetts State House has crowned Beacon Hill since 1798.

Directions: Your walk ends here.

In recent news: On October 8, 2026, the governor debated her challenger over the state budget, according to the State House News Service.
